scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build:prod --workspace=client
scripts.docker:build: docker compose build && docker builder prune --keep-storage 3g --force
scripts.docker:build:test: docker compose -p ythril-test -f testing/docker-compose.test.yml build && docker builder prune --keep-storage 3g --force
scripts.docker:down: docker compose down -v && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path'),d=p.join('config');try{fs.readdirSync(d).forEach(f=>fs.unlinkSync(p.join(d,f)))}catch{};console.log('Full uninstall complete — volumes + config/ removed')"
scripts.test:up: node testing/_init/stack-down.mjs --for-start && node testing/_init/reset-test-configs.mjs && docker compose -p ythril-test -f testing/docker-compose.test.yml up --build -d --wait --wait-timeout 300 && node testing/sync/setup.js
scripts.test:up:rebuild: node testing/_init/stack-down.mjs --for-start && node testing/_init/reset-test-configs.mjs && docker compose -p ythril-test -f testing/docker-compose.test.yml up --build -d --wait --wait-timeout 300 && npm run test:prune && node testing/sync/setup.js
scripts.test:prune: docker image prune -f && docker builder prune --keep-storage 5g --force
scripts.test:down:clean: node testing/_init/stack-down.mjs && docker builder prune --keep-storage 3g --force && docker image prune -f && docker volume prune -f
